_comment: Configurable drop chances. Saved changes apply within a few seconds. With enabled=false the built-in rates (identical to the values below) are used. Fields left out of a rule keep that rule's built-in value; to stop a drop set its enabled to false.
_rule_help: chance% = base_chance_percent + floor((fame - min_fame) / fame_per_bonus_percent) [capped by max_fame_bonus_percent, -1 = no cap] + lucky_bonus_percent (if the killer's luck roll succeeds), times global_multiplier (unless use_global_multiplier=false), capped by max_chance_percent. season refers to an id in world-time.json. amount = base + 1 per fame tier reached + 1 on a lucky roll (lucky_extra_chance_percent) + random 0..random_bonus_max.
